final: WITH patient_ratios AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) / AVG(HCT) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID HAVING AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(HCT) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_ratios), first_group AS (SELECT p.ID, p.ratio FROM patient_ratios p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.ratio > o.avg_ratio), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM first_group), final_group AS (SELECT f.ratio, f.ratio - o.avg_ratio AS above_overall, f.ratio - s.avg_ratio AS above_second FROM first_group f CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN second_average s WHERE f.ratio > s.avg_ratio) SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(above_overall) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(above_second) AS avg_above_second FROM final_group
